# 3D Template

The `3d` template is a small OpenGL-backed 3D scene example. It renders a floor grid and two colored cubes using the fixed runtime camera setup.

## Create and run

```bash
nexus new My3D --template 3d
cd My3D
nexus check
nexus build
nexus run
```

## What is included

The checked-in `examples/templates/3d.nx` demonstrates `gfx_init`, `gfx_poll`, `gfx3d_begin`, `gfx3d_grid`, `gfx3d_cube`, `gfx3d_end` and `gfx_shutdown`. Press Escape to exit the window.

This is not a complete 3D engine scaffold. The current runtime does not expose the shader compiler, arbitrary mesh builder, material/PBR system, animation controller, first-person mouse-look controller or scene graph described in older drafts. The model loader is experimental; consult [Graphics 3D](../runtime/graphics-3d.md) and `examples/native_3d.nx` for the supported calls.
